findings.title: G13 audit content-loss finding is false; joint G12/G13 edit is guide-authorised
evidence: frozen/D16/guide.json: G12:1 new_text = '赎回费用由赎回基金份额的基金份额持有人承担，在基金份额持有人赎回基金份额时收取。赎回费用全额计入基金财产。'

artifacts/D16/working_final.docx: report p221 equals the G12:1 new_text exactly; p222 is blank
frozen/D16/report.json audit.issues[0..1]: AUDIT_NOT_COMPLETED and AUDIT_MISSED_TARGET for G13 Y007, reasons claim the guide does not state the new sentence and that the allocation rule was removed
frozen/D02/report.json audit G12: '删除了按比例归入基金财产及 7 日/1.5% 的表述...未丢失要求内容'; audit G13: completed
frozen/D11/report.json audit G13: '剩余文字属于 G12 的授权改写'; audit G12: completed
frozen/D16/targets.json T015/T016 reasons uniquely require preserving the allocation rule; this is absent from the guide
findings.analysis: The final DOCX matches the certified guide exactly. G12:1 replaces the whole clause and removes the allocation rule by design; G13 only deletes the 7-day sentence, and that deletion is present. The audit misattributes a G12-authorised replacement to G13 and enforces a model-authored target rationale not present in the guide. All 24 obligations pass and claim replay is verified, yet delivery is blocked.
findings.action: Fix joint-edit audit attribution: G13 must verify only its delete effect; a G12-authorised replacement must not be reported as G13 content loss. Do not promote target rationales to requirements unless consistent with the guide. Add the D16 p221 case as a regression and re-run/replay D16.
